rule: blind proposals must not be variants, inversions, renamings or parameter rescues of any of these; A7-N maps every proposal against this inventory

forbidden_classes.forbidden: LOT/MAX/idiosyncratic-skew inversion, lookback retune, fee reduction, winning-symbol selection, renaming as a new mechanism
Amihud/illiquidity variants beyond the single preregistered replication identity
OI-deleveraging variants beyond the single preregistered OILEV-V2 identity; raising the 0.30 cap; post-score renormalisation
ordinary reversal or renamed rejected baselines
any proposal needing unavailable external data or a data purchase
